def solve(n):
    h1 = set()
    while n != 1 and n not in h1:
        h1.add(n)
        sum_squares = 0
        while n > 0:
            digit = n % 10
            sum_squares += digit * digit
            n //= 10
        n = sum_squares
    return n == 1

def solve(n):

    while n != 1 and n not in h1:
        h1.add(n)
        sum_squares = sum((int(digit) ** 2 for digit in str(n)))
        n = sum_squares
    return n == 1
